title: Internet time descends from atomic clocks in layers
body: NTP organises time as strata: stratum-0 devices are reference clocks like GPS receivers, stratum-1 servers read them directly, and each hop adds a stratum and a whisper of error. Your laptop typically drinks from stratum 2 or 3. The design, by David Mills from 1985, still disciplines most of the planet's machines to within milliseconds.
